subject.title: BL-ecommerce-catalog: Public Catalog — specs, aislamiento y tests

question: Should the Public Catalog BL block proceed with the corrected F1 inventory, and should `constants/categories/SEO` be validated here or moved to the Ecommerce SEO BL block?
rationale: The BL pipeline makes owner validation blocking, and the current issue discussion already identifies scope facts and a SEO/catalog boundary that cannot be safely settled by source inspection alone.

options.title: Proceed with corrected Public Catalog F1/F2
options.body: Validate the current 30-item page size, unconditional 15-item availability batching, live filters/sorting/pagination, and decide the SEO constants boundary during owner review.

options.title: Move SEO constants to the SEO block
options.body: Treat `constants/categories/SEO` as content/routing SEO unless the owner explicitly wants those rules documented under Public Catalog.

options.title: Pause until child cleanups land
options.body: Review the open child PRs first, then run F1/F2 against the simplified catalog/search code to avoid documenting dead paths.

recommendation.title: Proceed with corrected Public Catalog F1/F2
recommendation.body: Validate the current 30-item page size, unconditional 15-item availability batching, live filters/sorting/pagination, and decide the SEO constants boundary during owner review.

likelyOwner.reason: They are named as the block owner, assigned to the issue, and authored the related BL child issues discovered during extraction.
